design.name: 👁️ Show Sub Navigation
design.note: In shell-desktop the equivalent property is a variant axis with the values False and True.

design.name: 👁️ Show Drawer
design.note: Mobile only. Navigation level two and deeper can only be shown in the Drawer, desktop has no equivalent. Not offered on CP Navigation=Flat Icon, that variant contains no Drawer.

design.name: 🔀 CP Navigation
design.note: Design-only, no code counterpart is planned. The property exists to keep the Figma component usable and error-resistant, and because the Drawer is inserted in the Shell instead of the navigation. Code reaches the same result through a different implementation, so this is not a Figma-versus-code deviation. Flat Icon only exists in combination with Control Panel Mobile Position=Bottom and Sub Navigation Mobile Position=(Def) Top.

design.name: 🔀 Sub Navigation Mobile Position
design.note: Bottom only exists in combination with Control Panel Mobile Position=(Def) Top.
